description: Review caller-proposed owned-footage B-roll picks with matched quote, reason, alternatives, source/sequence revisions and explicit decisions. Reject overlapping approved placements. Does not infer visual content, search stock, inspect track occupancy or insert clips.

expected_review_revision.description: Revision from the initial review; required when selecting or rejecting entries. A changed input requires a new review.

placements.description: Caller-proposed video-only B-roll placements with captured revisions.

alternative_source_ids.description: Other caller-supplied footage candidates for re-review.

quote.description: Dialogue or editorial intent matched by the caller.

reason.description: Supplied reason for this pick; tool performs no vision inference.

sequence_id.description: Exact target sequence ID; re-inspect before later insertion.

source_end_seconds.description: Proposed source out point, greater than in.

timeline_start_seconds.description: Proposed destination start in sequence seconds.

rejected_ids.description: Explicitly rejected entry IDs. Unselected entries remain pending.

selected_ids.description: Explicitly approved entry IDs. Omit for an initial review; an empty array approves nothing.

name: review_broll_placements

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Review Broll Placements
